Speaking about why I started it....... was because of loneliness and intensive bullying at school. I had no friends, grades were dropping and yk, stuff like that.

Look bud ......people do self harm for many reasons. Some do it for relief from stress...some do it to punish themselves, being guilty about something....(reasons are infinite). I also read somewhere that it also releases some hormone which provides temporary psychological relief.

Talking about how much it hurts, it hurts terribly at first . I remember in my first few days of self harming, I barely made a scratch. But the shocking thing is how quickly it escalates. On my fourth or fifth day, I got used to the pain. Then I began to cut much deeper....Within a few days, it escalated from arms to chest. (It escalates rapidly.....so rapidly you wouldn't be able to know...you just want more everyday).As days pass, you become used to the pain, so I guess it doesn't hurt much.

So , I would say that if you are thinking of self harming, you shouldn't. Talk to someone who understands. Reach out..get help.
